description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when you create an application in the console. The ID consists of lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 创建人用户昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符。
description.en: The nickname of the creator. Chinese and English characters are supported. The maximum length is 32 characters.

description.zh: 创建人用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符。
description.en: The user ID of the creator. Only letters and digits are supported. The maximum length is 36 characters.

description.zh: 课程标题，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符。
description.en: The class title. Chinese and English characters are supported. The maximum length is 32 characters.
